This is a finite exhaustive certificate; no all-n extension is asserted.

value.rationale: This addresses the natural first alphabet-size boundary q=2 of the odd-length palindromic duplication sphere problem, where the distinct-letter sharpness proof cannot be used. It determines twenty consecutive exact maximum output-sphere sizes and all maximizing binary sources, giving a persistent rigidity pattern (two complementary period-four sources at every n=6..22) and an exact binary loss 2n-9 from the general commutation upper bound. Such a full finite ambiguity benchmark and optimizer classification are reusable for comparing finite-length synchronization channels and future binary all-length bounds, without requiring a paper-sized infinite theorem.
